nothing_pending: All your data is saved on the server
first_sync: Downloading the data of your area for the first time…
offline_hint: Your changes are saved on this device and uploaded automatically when the connection returns.
photos_waiting_wifi: Photos are waiting for a Wi-Fi connection
photos_waiting_record: Photos are uploaded after their records
wifi_only_hint: Saves mobile data: photos stay on the device until you are on Wi-Fi.
storage_persistent: The app's data is protected from automatic clean-up
storage_not_persistent: The browser may delete the app's data when the device runs out of space. Install the app on the home screen to protect it.
storage_unknown: This browser does not report storage usage
conflict_notice: This field was also changed on another device. The server's value is kept until a supervisor decides.
error_network: Could not reach the server. We will try again automatically.
error_timeout: The server took too long to answer. We will try again automatically.
error_auth: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue syncing.
error_revoked: An administrator has blocked this device or account. The data stored on it was removed.
error_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
error_rate_limited: Too many requests right now. We will try again shortly.
error_server: The server has a temporary problem. We will try again automatically.
error_storage_full: The device storage is full. Free some space and try again; none of your data was lost.
error_invalid: The server refused the request. Update the app and try again.
error_unknown: An unexpected error occurred while syncing.
rejected_out_of_scope: The record is outside your area of responsibility.
rejected_not_owner: Only the person who created this record or a supervisor can change it.
rejected_parent_missing: The project this change belongs to has not reached the server yet.
rejected_parent_deleted: The project this change belongs to was deleted.
rejected_row_deleted: This record was deleted on the server.
rejected_forbidden_transition: Changing the state of this record requires a supervisor.
rejected_invalid_transition: The record cannot be moved to this state.
rejected_check_violation: The record contains a value that is not accepted. Correct it and try again.
rejected_photo_limit_exceeded: The project already has the maximum number of photos.
rejected_call_failed: The server could not process this change.
